claims.text: The change in positive review share was driven in part by reviewer composition shifts, with a composition effect of -0.56 points.
Review volume in the window totaled 5321 reviews compared to 1936 reviews in the baseline window.
Players with less than 2 hours of playtime accounted for 3.18% of the window mix compared to 2.12% in the baseline.
The 14-day horizon patch effect estimate on positive share was -1.52 percentage points.

report.summary: Review volume totaled 5321 reviews compared to 1936 reviews in the baseline window, with an overall positive share of 91.84%. Players with less than 2 hours of playtime accounted for 3.18% of the window mix compared to 2.12% in the baseline. The change in positive review share was driven in part by reviewer composition shifts, with a composition effect of -0.56 points, while the 14-day horizon patch effect estimate on positive share was -1.52 percentage points, and off-topic negative review mentions remained at 0.0%. A change in who reviewed is supported, while the patch, a price change or sale, off-topic reviews or a review bomb, and noise or seasonality are inconclusive.
